worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.summary: Work around the target and rake it from a new angle again and again; one whiff ends the pass. You can point at an enemy or just give a direction and keep raking along the real contact, so a target behind a wall is not chased. The roaming form sweeps wider, circles farther and lands more often; the pounce form presses straight in, narrows to one lane and hits each rake harder.
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.use.0: Circle a nearby target while raking it over and over
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.use.1: Rake from the side and rear, forcing the target to keep turning
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.use.2: Pounce form presses in and pins the target against one side
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.use.3: Start from a direction alone and keep raking along the real contact
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.description: Each rake deals about %1$s contact damage (Attack-driven); up to %2$s rakes per pass, each at %3$s accuracy. One whiff ends the pass.
Claw reach %1$s blocks, rake arc %2$s degrees; you reposition %3$s blocks before each rake, %4$s between rakes. Each rake's arc hits 1-2 targets (a wider arc reaches more).
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.pounce.on: Pounce form: press straight in, each rake heavier and farther, pinning the target to one side; the cost is a narrowed arc, almost no sidestep and slightly lower accuracy.
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.pounce.off: Roaming form: alternate sides around the target, wider arc, longer sidestep and higher accuracy, forcing the target to keep turning to reach you; the cost is slightly lighter rakes and less reach.
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.timing: Range %1$s blocks, prepare %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.growth.0: At level %1$s, each rake rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.growth.1: At level %1$s, each rake %2$s and claw reach %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.furyswipes.growth.2: At level %1$s, each rake %2$s and sidestep %3$s blocks.
On (pounce): press straight in, each rake x1.08 power and x1.12 reach, pinning the target to one side; the cost is x0.8 arc (narrowed to one lane), almost no sidestep, -3% accuracy and +1 tick interval. Off (roaming): alternate sides, x1.12 arc, x1.25 sidestep and +3% accuracy, forcing the target to keep turning; the cost is x0.9 per rake and x0.92 reach.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first instead of leaping in to rake. Higher values start the pass from farther out.
On: opens the pass more readily when the target is below four-tenths health, to rake it down; off: all targets rank the same.
On: under a hold order it will still leave its post to rake; off: only casts when the target is already in reach.
